theorems.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} (l : Filter ι) (m : ι → ℝ) (a b : ℕ → ι → ℝ) (A B : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ), (∀ k, ∀ᶠ i in l, a k i ≤ m i ∧ m i ≤ b k i) → (∀ k, Tendsto (a k) l (𝓝 (A k))) → (∀ k, Tendsto (b k) l (𝓝 (B k))) → Tendsto A atTop (𝓝 L) → Tendsto B atTop (𝓝 L) → Tendsto m l (𝓝 L)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
